stops.name: Openluchtmuseum
stops.detail: A few kilometers north of Arnhem, there is also a zoo and the open-air museum (Dutch: Openluchtmuseum), where residential architecture from past times and former life in the Dutch provinces are shown.

stops.name: Kröller-Müller-Museum
stops.detail: The Hoge Veluwe National Park also offers the significant Kröller-Müller Museum with a large van Gogh collection and the sculpture park at the Kröller-Müller Museum with modern sculptures.
